item.title: Design a Rate Limiter
item.description: Picture this: it’s Black Friday. Millions of shoppers hammer your checkout API at the same moment. Without a rate limiter, your servers buckle, legitimate customers get errors, and your database melts. A rate limiter is the bouncer at the door — it decides who gets in and how fast. In this article, we’ll build a rate limiter from scratch — understanding every algorithm, every tradeoff, and every subtle distributed-systems problem you’ll hit in real life.
